name: B10-0462/2026 (S&D) – Human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making demands. It condemns Iran's use of the death penalty against protesters and names two women, Leila Abolhasani and Taraneh Rahimi, who have been sentenced to death. It asks Iran to stop all executions, release detained minors, and allow independent investigations. It also asks the European Union to widen sanctions and protect Iranians living in Europe from pressure by the Iranian government.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; these are demands, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Iran's government, judges and officials; Iranians in Europe.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU governments, the UN and Iran; no action is binding.
